blocks.text: The Progression of Democracy in Korea
Because Korea has been a democratic country for a short period of time, many people today still do not have a good understanding of how the political system of our country works.
Not only do some people not have a good understanding of democracy, but our politicians also lack this knowledge as well.
We all have a lot to learn about how to make the democratic system of government function effectively in Korea.
